revisions.name: $th_mmx_copy64
revisions.reason: Qualified straight MMX copy only: each mapping helper executes with its literal original instruction EIP; successful loads commit coherent physical images and each completed line publishes GPRs/flags. Faults return before later instructions and resume at the failed access. The exact 17 EIP targets are inventoried; no callback boundary, ownership write, or lifetime clearance changes. Ownership remains pending and nonlocal APIs remain disabled.
